name: E.P.T.F
detailed_description:
You’ve just joined an agency tasked with managing the world’s most chaotic anomalies—E.P. (Extraordinary Phenomena)—as a low-level field agent.

Under the agency’s orders, you'll explore E.P.-infested areas, photograph traces of their presence, and collect anomalous items infused with their energy. Use these to enhance your own abilities or upgrade headquarters facilities.

Ultimately, you must face an impending apocalyptic threat.

■ A Catastrophic Force Is Approaching

An end-of-the-world event is on the horizon, and the countdown has begun.

You’re given 30 days (in-game scenario time) to take action and prevent global destruction.

The powerful force behind this scenario is spreading its influence across multiple regions, spawning E.P.s along the way.

■ Investigate to Uncover the Nature of the Apocalypse

By completing exploration missions on-site, you'll earn Omen Points.

Spend these points on the world map to trigger Omen Events, allowing you to uncover the scenario boss’s weaknesses or weaken it in advance.

■ Track and Eliminate Local E.P.s

Complete tracking missions to make the E.P.s occupying a region appear.

Defeat them to cleanse the area and earn more Omen Points.

■ Strengthen Yourself Before It’s Too Late

You only have 30 days.

Train at headquarters, craft gear, and enhance your equipment to prepare for the final confrontation.

■ The World Is Never Safe for Long

Saving the world once is not the end.

The game features multiple scenarios. After one ends, another begins—each with a new threat to face.

Continue fighting to protect the world from recurring disasters.

short_description: [E.P.T.F.] is an item farming simulation RPG game that becomes an agent of an agency, farms items, and removes/captures the E.P. that causes them.You can strengthen the headquarters' facilities and foster characters with items obtained through exploration.
